units: Cancer-cell fractions exclude normal cells; tree times are arbitrary ordering units, not years.
mutation_id_format: segment_id + period + batch_id + period + 3-digit zero-padded within-batch index; example S001.T_low.001
mutation_order: segment ascending, explicit mutation_class_order, batch_id lexicographic, within-batch index ascending
snv_coordinates: Use seed(split,variant_id,replicate,coordinates,segment_id). Draw rng.choice(1000000,size=n,replace=False,shuffle=True), sort offsets, add 1-based segment start, and assign in explicit mutation order.
copy_number_authority: Final validated_copy_truth.cn_by_tip determines original major=max(H1,H2), minor=min(H1,H2), total and read denominator. trunk_gain_target_major is only a trunk_gain recipe parameter.

read_generation.paired_masks: Reuse the identical latent counts; change observation flags only.

fit_seeds.restart_indexing: Positive integers beginning at1; no B/C arm name in shared key; support remains part of model/cache identity.

source_interventions: Controlled source labels are diagnostic fixtures only. In natural runs A estimates G0; B and C reuse that G0 and fit their own remainder groups. B3 and C3 use the corresponding frozen references.

observation_policy_definitions.observed_zero_ALT_for_B_R1: No mask. B has true CCF0 in R1, so binomial ALT=0; keep positive sampled depth as observed evidence.
observation_policy_definitions.deterministic_missing_excluded_zero_dept: Let j be 1-based global mutation rank. R2 missing if j%5==0; R3 excluded if j%10==0; R4 zero-depth if j%10==1. Finally j<=30 is missing in all regions, overriding and clearing the preceding regional exclusion/zero-depth rules for those mutations. Preserve distinctions and propagate identical input masks through all stages.
observation_policy_definitions.no_assayed_trunk: No input mask. Assayed T count0; do not insert a clonal reference.
observation_policy_definitions.monoclonal_empty_remainder_control: No mask. One true group; controlled accepted G0=all1500 tests empty Stage2. Native model selection remains empirical.
observation_policy_definitions.mask_nontrunk_R4: Mark every class A/B/C mutation as missing in R4. T remains observed. Controlled G0=T creates an unsupported nonempty Stage2 fitting region.

matched_R4_mask.rule: Reuse same truth and reads; in each T or A segment/batch, mask R4 for within-batch indices 1 through floor(batch_count/2). Other mutations retain R4. This masks 450 mutation-region pairs in S04.03/S12.04 and 400 in S05.04. Do not count as independent histories.

S11_reference_panel.base: complete truth reference from realized CCFs
variants: duplicate A once with distinct label
replace A CCF by min(1,phi_A+0.15) coordinatewise
S11_reference_panel.scope: controlled external-target assignment; not a production reference update

incompatible_prediction.scope: standalone prediction fixture, not an accepted same-input workflow target

no_information_prediction.counts: all missing or all zero depth in separate tests
no_information_prediction.scope: standalone prediction fixture, not assumed to originate from informative-only accepted fitting
